title: Baker Victory Services training to quantum unentangle
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Baker Victory Services training to quantum unentangle, about guest's childhood at Baker Victory Services, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: at Baker Victory Services, a lot of their work was having you quantum unentangle with things that you were entangled with.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, interviewing a guest who says they were taken into a UFO program as a child, talks about a place called Baker Victory Services from the guest's childhood. Michels says much of the work there involved teaching people to "quantum unentangle," meaning to cut hidden connections between themselves and things they were linked to. If true, it would mean children were being trained in unusual mental skills.
